threads.omitted: {count} more open threads are not shown; the next are at read_threads(start={next}).
threads.wake_omitted: {count} more open threads are not listed; read_threads().
threads.archive_heading: ## Moved by the operator on {date}: finished threads, as they stood in {legacy_name}
threads.move_comment: <!-- Moved by the operator on {date} from {legacy_name}, unchanged. -->
threads.list_error: Nothing was changed: list title {title} matches {count} entries.
threads.archive_noop: Moved 0 entries and 0 bytes: the listed entries were already archived; nothing was changed.
threads.split_noop: Wrote 0 thread files: the old file is absent; nothing was changed.
threads.resolved_error: Nothing was changed: resolved entry {title} remains in the old file.
threads.split_collision: Nothing was changed: {first} and {second} have the same slug.
threads.check_error: Entry {title} is not accounted for exactly once with its original bytes.

errors.title: the title must be a non-empty single line
errors.slug: the title has no letters or digits for a file name
errors.exists: an open thread already has that title
errors.missing: no open thread has that title
errors.shape: the file has no open status or required sections
errors.closure: how_it_closed must be a non-empty single line
errors.closed_in: closed_in must be empty or a closing such as SR-0152 or SR-0152-2
errors.closed_shape: the closed thread file has no wake number
errors.closing_missing: no thread with that title closed in that wake
errors.any_missing: no open or closed thread has that title
errors.start: start must be a whole number from 1 to the number of open threads

suggestions.open_one: no open thread has that exact title; one open title contains it: {title}
suggestions.open_many: no open thread has that exact title; {count} open titles contain it: {titles}
suggestions.closed_one: no closed thread has that exact title; one closed title contains it: {title}
suggestions.closed_many: no closed thread has that exact title; {count} closed titles contain it: {titles}

threads.read_threads_description: Lists open thread titles, newest update dates and byte sizes, then counts closed threads; start selects the first position shown.
threads.read_thread_description: Returns the open thread or latest closing in full; closed_in selects a closing such as SR-0152 or SR-0152-2.
